CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user_notifications()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.notification_settings (user_id)
  VALUES (NEW.id)
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_type user_type := 'private'; v_avatar text := new.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url'; begin if new.raw_user_meta_data->>'user_type' = 'agent' then v_type := 'agent'; end if; -- the only choice a sign-up form offers if v_avatar is not null and v_avatar !~ '^https://' then v_avatar := null; end if; -- the value is rendered in insert into public.users (id, name, phone, avatar_url, role, user_type, is_verified, created_at) values ( new.id, left(coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', split_part(new.email, '@', 1)), 200), left(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone', 32), left(v_avatar, 2000), 'user'::user_role, -- never from metadata: administrators are made by an administrator with service_role v_type, false, now() ) on conflict (id) do nothing; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_users_protected_columns()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  -- service_role, the table owner and SECURITY DEFINER functions are trusted; an active administrator acting through a session is too
  if current_user not in ('authenticated', 'anon') or public.caller_is_admin() then return new; end if;
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    -- a session may only ever insert a plain, active, unverified, never-sanctioned user (no policy allows an insert today; this does not depend on that)
    if new.role::text <> 'user'
    or coalesce(new.is_verified, false)
    or coalesce(new.status::text, 'active') <> 'active'
    or new.block_reason is not null
    or new.suspended_until is not null
    or new.deleted_at is not null then
      raise exception 'protected column' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    return new;
  end if;
  if new.id is distinct from old.id
  or new.role is distinct from old.role
  or new.is_verified is distinct from old.is_verified
  or new.status is distinct from old.status
  or new.block_reason is distinct from old.block_reason
  or new.suspended_until is distinct from old.suspended_until
  or new.deleted_at is distinct from old.deleted_at
  or new.public_id is distinct from old.public_id then
    raise exception 'protected column' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
